author_reading.rationale: Two independently synchronized single-source bits are packed into separate bits of one output word with one output delay: field intent and coherence are not stated.

labels.rationale: status_o packs separate sources behind independent synchronizers. The output delay states the capture clock, but the consumer's expectations for field independence or whole-word coherence are unspecified.

Two distinct source bits a_src_q and b_src_q (src_clk) are independently synchronized into dst_clk via u_sync_a (a_s) and u_sync_b (b_s) and packed onto a single 2-bit top-level output port status_o = {b_s, a_s} (design.sv:37) under set_output_delay -clock dst_clk (intent.sdc:6), leaving multi-bit word coherence vs. independent-field consumer intent unresolved (CST-012 WARNING Unresolved).
